definitions.ild: mean pairwise cosine distance between the picks' vectors (higher = more varied)
definitions.format_spread: entropy of the picks' formats over log(list length); 1 = every pick a different format
definitions.novelty: 1 - popularity percentile within the source (votes, views or citations); 1 = rarely seen
definitions.unexpectedness: 1 - percentile of closeness to the person's own words (keyword overlap, session similarity)
definitions.serendipity: mean of good * unexpectedness over the picks
definitions.grounding: mean over the top-k picks of good * supported * min(E, 3) / 3, E = independent evidence types (TMDB keyword, quoted theme, overview similarity; co-mention is not available yet). Distance earns nothing
definitions.theme_coverage: share of the session's linkable supported themes served by at least one good, supported pick
definitions.overreach: GATE: share of shown picks labelled not supported (proxy: bad with reason 'relevance'); lower is better
definitions.creative_grounded: STRICT: share of picks that are good, supported, backed by >= 2 evidence types AND far from what the person said (unexpectedness >= 0.5). Reported with its count; reaching further cannot raise it
definitions.creative_grounded_soft: SOFT: mean of good * supported * min(E,3)/3 * unexpectedness; any pick that is bad, overreaching or unevidenced scores 0 however far it is
definitions.evidence_mean: mean number of evidence types per pick (0 to 3)
definitions.interest_coverage: share of the session's own interests that at least one shown pick answers
definitions.unique_share: distinct items / slots shown across all lists (1 = no item is ever repeated); point value, no interval
definitions.gini: inequality of how often each shown item appears (0 = all equally often)
definitions.top_item_share: the most repeated item's share of all slots
